name: HYPR
summary: HYPR is a passwordless and multi-factor authentication platform for workforce and customer sign-in. Its pricing page lists Identity Assurance plans at $3, $6 and $9 per user a month, and its Adapt product adds risk scoring and adaptive authentication.

evidence.capability: second-factor methods such as app push or hardware keys

facts.text: The pricing page lists FIDO2 security keys and PIV, WebAuthn passkeys and the HYPR Authenticate mobile app among its workforce authentication methods.
The pricing page lists Adaptive Authentication and Real-Time Risk Scoring under HYPR Adapt for workforce use, and Risk Based Authentication under Adapt for customer identity.

HYPR's policy management documentation says administrators create the policies that govern access to an application, and use on/off switches to manage enabled authenticators. The Registration Policy sets the authenticator options shown to users when they enroll a device.
The documentation says disabling or enabling an authenticator affects every user already enrolled with it.
The pricing page shows Contact Sales for the customer identity platform tier and for several add-on products, and says volume pricing is available at 100,000 users and above.

plans.name: Identity Assurance Access
plans.notes: Billing term (monthly or annual) not stated on the pricing page. The page does not say which features each plan includes, because feature availability is shown with checkmark images.

plans.name: Identity Assurance Plus
plans.notes: Billing term not stated. Plan contents not stated in text.

plans.name: Identity Assurance Advanced
plans.notes: Billing term not stated. Labelled Popular on the pricing page. Plan contents not stated in text.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page shows dollar signs but does not name a currency.
The page does not state whether the per-user price is billed monthly or annually.
The page does not show which plan includes adaptive authentication or risk scoring, so confirm that the risk-based rules feature is included in the plan being bought.
Customer identity and several add-on products are quote-only (Contact Sales).
